What you’re looking at

Blue lines show recorded API estimates. Gold lines show measured departures from the City dataset, linked only when stop, destination and scheduled time match uniquely. This is a record match, not a verified trip-ID match: City performance records do not include trip or bus IDs.

Trip order and bus identity come from the API. Clock-only trip times are anchored to a dated stop observation for that trip and bus; ambiguous records are omitted. A past estimate does not confirm a bus passed a stop. Actual arrival times are unavailable, and missing measured records are never treated as on time.

The ±2-minute band is an exploratory comparison, not an official service standard. A trip can include several captured snapshots. This page uses an exported snapshot of the local collector; reloading checks for a newer export, not a direct connection to a live bus.
